theme_and_archetype.description: An objective, scientific, and slightly cautious interface mimicking a laboratory clinical dashboard. Ensures users do not get a false sense of security (no reassuring greens). Focuses on clarity, high contrast, and data density.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mode B (Control Room Grid). Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).

buttons.primary: bg-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white font-medium rounded-sm px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white hover:bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 font-medium rounded-sm px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-600 border border-red-200 font-medium rounded-sm px-6 py-3 transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-sm shadow-sm flex flex-col
cards.data_panel: bg-zinc-50 border border-zinc-200 rounded-sm p-4 font-mono text-sm

badges.warning: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-200 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono rounded-none uppercase
badges.danger: bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono rounded-none uppercase
badges.neutral: bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono rounded-none uppercase

alerts.mandatory_warning: bg-red-50 border-l-4 border-red-600 p-4 text-red-800 flex items-start space-x-3 text-sm font-medium

animations_and_motion.scanner_overlay: Pulsing horizontal line (bg-sky-500/50) translating vertically via Framer Motion. duration: 2s, repeat: Infinity.
animations_and_motion.data_reveal: Staggered fade-up (y: 10, opacity: 0 -> 1) for structured JSON output fields to mimic progressive analysis.
animations_and_motion.hover_states: Micro-lift (-translate-y-[2px]) and shadow-md on history cards.
animations_and_motion.page_transitions: Instant or very fast (0.15s ease-out) to maintain the clinical, fast-response feel.

home_landing.layout: Centered stark hero section. Large 'WaterTruth AI' wordmark. Explicit clinical disclaimer visible before scanning starts.

camera_scanner.layout: Full viewport or large centered container taking 80vh.
camera_scanner.visuals: Camera feed with technical overlays: crosshairs, four corner brackets, pulsing scan line. Absolute positioned prominent warning text at bottom ('VISUAL ANALYSIS ONLY - NOT FOR SAFETY VERIFICATION').

results.layout: Bento grid. Left column (Image + Classification Badge + Drinkability Verdict). Right column (Structured JSON Data + Confidence Score + Visual Properties).
components: Data Grid (Color, Clarity, Particles) in Monospace

history.layout: Dense data table or grid of compact cards. Mode B Control Room Grid.

hero_background.description: Laboratory flask with blue liquid, used for landing page abstract background or hero banner accent.

demo_polluted_water.description: Muddy water with ripples, suitable for history feed placeholder or demo.

demo_clean_water.description: Hand gently cupping flowing river water. Use as placeholder for CLEAN classification.

microscope_analysis.description: Female researcher examining samples. Use for about section or loading states.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text strictly follows APCA/WCAG AA. Danger alerts have minimum 4.5:1 contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color mappings. Never use green for 'CLEAN' or 'SAFE', use #0EA5E9 (Clinical Sky Blue) to maintain objective analysis tone.
Use IBM Plex Sans for headings and IBM Plex Mono for all data/metrics/JSON properties. Import from Google Fonts.
Build the Scanner UI with an active tracking visual (corner brackets, scanner line) to reinforce the 'AI Vision' technical feel.
The history page must look like a data log, not a social feed. Use dense grids, monospace timestamps, and sharp borders.
Implement the mandatory safety warning as an intrusive, unmissable banner on the Results screen.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and major output panels as specified.
